# Job Description — Junior Python Developer

## Job Title

Junior Python Developer

## Experience

0 to 2 Years

## Location

Mumbai / Remote

## Job Summary

We are looking for a Junior Python Developer to build backend applications, APIs, and database-driven systems. Freshers with strong projects and coding skills can apply.

## Responsibilities

* Develop backend features using Python
* Build REST APIs
* Work with MySQL / SQL databases
* Debug and maintain applications
* Collaborate with frontend developers
* Write clean and reusable code

## Required Skills

* Python
* SQL / MySQL
* HTML, CSS, JavaScript
* Basic DSA
* OOP concepts
* Git / GitHub

## Preferred Skills

* Flask / FastAPI / Django
* React.js
* Tailwind CSS
* API Integration
* AI tools / LLM basics

## Preferred Projects

* Management systems
* AI tools
* Dashboards
* Web apps
* Tracking systems

## Education

BCA / BSc CS / BTech / Related Degree

## Soft Skills

* Communication
* Problem solving
* Quick learner
* Teamwork

## Interview Process

Resume Screening → Technical Round → Final HR Round

* Collaborate with team members on projects
* Create clean, maintainable, and efficient code

* Python, Java, C++, SQL

* Flask / Django / PHP
* GitHub, Tableau, Excel, VS Code
